headline: Stonecradle Ignites as Linn of Mercy Endures Relentless Border Attrition
war_summary: Since our previous filing, the conflict has ignited violently in Stonecradle, where seven rapid base turnovers unfolded across The Dais and The Reach alongside nearly a thousand fresh casualties in two hours. The carnage in Linn of Mercy accelerated rather than waned, swallowing nearly thirty-four hundred men in the same span while logging six more swings between Lathair and Outwich Ranch. In Weathered Expanse, relentless pressure yielded five further changes of hands among Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest, and Necropolis under heavy reciprocal fire. Along the Farranac Coast, Transient Valley changed hands twice more as casualty tallies surged past fifteen hundred in two hours. Skirmishing also nudged Stlican Shelf, where three swift transitions shook Breaker Town. By contrast, several formerly blazing sectors have cooled: Palantine Berm recorded no territorial shifts over the last two hours despite lingering combat, Marban Hollow tapered down to a solitary exchange at Checkpoint Bua, and the northern front in Nevish Line lapsed into silence.
